scope: Drain only the exact lightweight production pending queue through linked continuation batches; protected snapshots excluded.

frozen_queue.predicate: falsification_status in {unresolved,deferred} and no persisted falsification iterations
frozen_queue.digest_encoding: UTF-8 SHA-256 of compact JSON arrays; finding IDs sorted ascending, group member IDs retained in production queue order

per_batch_breakers.execution_note: Apply the call and token breakers before each batch; verify calculated cost after every completed batch before continuing.

data_transfer.content: Bounded repository-derived evidence from the frozen lightweight snapshot queue

execution_policy.batching: Run linked batches sequentially and retain every completed or failed run before deciding whether to continue.
execution_policy.prior_spend: All earlier calls, tokens, costs, and unknown-usage attempts remain separately accounted and are not reauthorized.
execution_policy.queue_completion: Stop immediately when the lightweight production pending queue reaches zero; unused ceilings expire.

stop_conditions: The repository identity, snapshot commit, pending predicate, or either frozen queue digest changes before the first batch.
Any new provider attempt lacks authoritative usage metadata.
Any batch fails or encounters a transport timeout.
Any aggregate or per-batch call, token, or dollar ceiling is reached or would be exceeded.
The lightweight pending queue reaches zero.
protected_pair: Neither protected serialize-javascript snapshot is authorized by this receipt.
next_gate: Merge this receipt, then obtain explicit authorization for its exact frozen scope, evidence transfer, and ceilings before reading the keychain or making provider calls.
